svg.title: What a tap on a player does
svg.desc: Ada plays, and a tap on Bob switches. The extension renews Bob's session at Autodarts with his parked token or, when Autodarts refuses the token, with his remembered password. When that fails, the page stays as it is and no token is lost: Bob has to sign in again when Autodarts refused him, and a tap later tries again when Autodarts couldn't be reached. Otherwise the extension saves Bob's fresh token, parks Ada's session from the page, still valid at Autodarts, writes Bob's session into the page and reloads it, and every other Autodarts tab reloads as Bob.
